$comment: The one source for what NexaScan offers on Free and Pro. Checked against the app's product catalogue (config/PrivatePdfToolkit/product-catalog.json) at app commit 510bfb1, Google Play versionCode 8, and against the installed app. Change the app first, then this file. The Features and Pricing pages are generated from it. 'limit' is the Free limit; Pro lifts it (the app never promises 'unlimited').

pricing.$comment: Prices come from Google Play at run time, not from the app. Set confirmed to true only when the owner confirms the production prices; until then the site says prices are shown in Google Play.
